name: 01-carbon-copper
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally polished professional mobile app home screen for "Infra Control", Spanish personal infrastructure remote control app. Flat edge-to-edge screen artwork, portrait 1024x1536, no phone chassis, no perspective, no surrounding presentation, no multiple screens. The entire screen fits including bottom tab bar. Professional product designer quality, meticulous typography, mature readable sans-serif, generous measured spacing, realistic implementable interface, sharp legible Spanish text. This is a VISUAL EXPLORATION with a small "DEMO" pill in top header. All four concepts show exactly the same simulated state and functions. Content hierarchy: top small brand "infra control", small DEMO badge, settings gear. Greeting "Buenas noches, Admin" and title "Tu espacio, conectado." Below a status dot with "Sin alertas" and muted "Última lectura hace 12 s". Main prominent PC card: eyebrow "CASA", title "PC de casa", status "En línea", "CachyOS", supporting "Último aviso hace 12 s", a tasteful SMALL non-pixel desktop computer illustration occupying at most 20% of the card. Clearly accessible two controls "Cambiar sistema" with chevron and "Apagar" secondary understated red text with power icon, never a toggle for shutting down. Within lower part of same card a visually connected compact router row: "FiberHome", "Reportando · hace 25 s", subtle caption "No confirma acceso a Internet", and small action "Leer". Next compact card: small geometric icon, "Hermes", "Orquestador · EC2", badge "Encendida", "Observado hace 40 s", actions "Consultar" and "Energía". Below two compact small tiles side by side: "MacBook" / "Sin agente" and "Nube" / "Ver equipos" (no invented numbers, charts or metrics). Bottom fixed navigation with 4 line icons and exact labels "Inicio", "Equipos", "Actividad", "Costes", Inicio selected. All important content visible in one viewport with bottom padding. Text and icons must be highly legible. No fake graphs, no marketing call to action, no unrelated widgets. Strong hierarchy, genuinely distinct design system. DIRECTION 1 — CARBON / COPPER. Premium dark instrument interface. Near-black graphite background #111315, charcoal panels #1C1F22, hairline borders #34383C, ivory type, restrained burnished copper #C79570 highlight on active tab and main action, muted mint status dots. Elegant condensed-free neo-grotesk typography, large confident title with tight tracking. 20px rounded cards, refined subtle lighting, NO glass blur, NO purple, NO neon. Small photoreal clay/aluminium desktop illustration with copper light, compact. Crisp dense precision like a premium audio controller or design workstation. Primary PC card beautifully organized with light copper "Cambiar sistema" pill, demoted power action. Tone: calm technical luxury, excellent contrast.
